UPPCS Toppers List 2026 Out: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) released the UPPSC PCS Toppers List on 29th March 2026. The list has been announced for the Uttar Pradesh Combined State/Upper Subordinate Exam (UPPSC PCS) 2024 cycle, along with the final result. The topper list contains the marks-wise list of the finally shortlisted candidates who qualified the Prelims, Mains, and Interview stages. Candidates who had appeared for the exam can check the UPPSC Toppers List, download link, and other details here.




यूपीपीसीएस टॉपर्स लिस्ट 2026 जारी: उत्तर प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोग (यूपीएससी) ने यूपीपीएससी पीसीएस टॉपर्स लिस्ट जारी कर दी है। यह लिस्ट उत्तर प्रदेश संयुक्त राज्य/उच्च अधीनस्थ परीक्षा (यूपीएससी पीसीएस) 2024 के अंतिम परिणाम के साथ जारी की गई है। टॉपर्स लिस्ट में प्रारंभिक, मुख्य और साक्षात्कार चरणों में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले उम्मीदवारों के अंकों के अनुसार विवरण शामिल है। परीक्षा में शामिल हुए उम्मीदवार यूपीपीएससी टॉपर्स लिस्ट, डाउनलोड लिंक और अन्य विवरण यहां देख सकते हैं।

UPPCS Toppers List 2024 Out
The UPPCS Toppers List for the 2024 cycle has been released @uppsc.up.nic.in, after the completion of the interview stage from 16th February 2026 to 20th March 2026. The final result for the exam has also been announced. A total of 2719 candidates had appeared for the interview. Of these, 932 candidates have been shortlisted for the vacancies under the Uttar Pradesh State and Upper Subordinate Services. For the post of Deputy Collector, Neha Panchal topped the exam, followed by Ananaya Trivedi and Abhay Pratap Singh, in second and third positions.
यूपीपीसीएस के 2024 सत्र के टॉपर्स की सूची @uppsc.up.nic.in पर जारी कर दी गई है। साक्षात्कार प्रक्रिया 16 फरवरी 2026 से 20 मार्च 2026 तक संपन्न हुई थी। परीक्षा का अंतिम परिणाम भी घोषित कर दिया गया है। कुल 2719 उम्मीदवारों ने साक्षात्कार में भाग लिया था। इनमें से 932 उम्मीदवारों को उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य और उच्च अधीनस्थ सेवाओं के अंतर्गत रिक्त पदों के लिए चयनित किया गया है। उप कलेक्टर पद के लिए नेहा पंचाल ने प्रथम स्थान प्राप्त किया, जबकि अनन्या त्रिवेदी क्रमशः दूसरे और अभय प्रताप सिंह तीसरे स्थान पर रहीं।

How to Download UPPSC PCS Toppers Lists 2026?
The final UPPCS Merit List PDF is available for download on the commission’s official website. To download the result PDF, follow the steps mentioned below:
Step 1: Go to the UPPSC official website @uppsc.up.nic.in.
Step 2: Proceed to the Results section under the ‘Important Segments’.
Step 3: Click on the UPPCS Final Result download link.
Step 4: The UPPSC Result PDF will appear on your screen. Find your roll number/ name in the result.
Step 5: Download and save the result for reference.
Details Mentioned on the UPPCS Toppers List 2026
The UPPSC PCS Toppers List is a part of the final result PDF. I contains the roll number-wise list of candidates shortlisted for final appointment, in the order of merit. It also contains other important details. Candidates must make sure to check these details carefully to avoid any discrepancies later. The information mentioned on the final UPPCS Result includes:

Exam Cycle
Exam Dates
Number of shortlisted candidates
Names and roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates
The category of the candidates.

FAQs on UPPCS Toppers List 2026
Ques: When was the UPPCS Toppers List 2024 released?
Ans: The UPPSC PCS Topper List was announced on 29th March 2026.
Ques: On what basis is the UPPSC PCS Merit List prepared?
Ans: The UPPSC merit list is prepared based on the marks scored by the candidates in the Mains Exam and Interview.
Ques: What are the details given in the UPPCS Topper List 2026?
Ans: The UPPSC PCS Toppers List contains the names, roll numbers, and categories of the shortlisted candidates. Other than that, the number of shortlisted candidates, exam date, instructions for further selection, etc., are also mentioned on the result.
Ques: Where can I find the UPPCS Toppers List PDF 2026?
Ans: The UPPSC PCS Result PDF is available on the commission’s official website @uppsc.up.nic.in.
Ques: Who topped the UPPSC PCS 2024 Exam?
Ans: Neha Panchal topped the UPPSC PCS Exam for the 2024 cycle for the post of Deputy Collector.
